rows: What's the master biosynthetic pathway for spice aromatics?
Phenylpropanoid pathway: phenylalanine → cinnamic acid → multiple branches → eugenol, cinnamaldehyde, anethole, curcumin, capsaicin backbone
TRPV1 — thermosensor (fires >43°C); capsaicin opens it at room temp. Discovered David Julius, Nobel 2021.
TRPA1 — explains the different quality of burn (acute nasal/sinus hit vs lingering mouth burn of capsaicin)
Why do carvone enantiomers smell different?
Olfactory receptors (GPCRs) are made of chiral amino acids → inherently chiral binding pockets → distinguish mirror images
CB2 receptor agonist — a dietary cannabinoid. Found in cloves, black pepper, rosemary. No psychoactivity (CB2 is peripheral, not CNS).
Why does fat relieve capsaicin burn but water doesn't?
Capsaicin is hydrophobic — water disperses it; fat/casein dissolves and removes it from receptor sites
